mapper.insert: insert into ele_account( clilent_no, name, account_no, mobile, cert_no, ele_account_no, agreement_no, add_date, add_time, ele_account_status ) values( #{clilent_no}, #{name}, #{account_no}, #{mobile}, #{cert_no}, #{ele_account_no}, #{agreement_no}, DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%Y-%m-%d'), DATE_FORMAT(NOW(), '%H:%i:%s'), '1' )
mapper.select: select * from ele_account where cert_no = #{cert_no} and ele_account_status = '1'
